column1: # ksim-bench's regression bounds (P2 Q8; tools/ci.d/75-bench.sh): the most ns a
# 1400-octet packet may cost in the release build. Measured on the dev PC on
# 2026-10-16 (KS-PLAT-T57). The PDCP cases are bounded at about 1.7x, tight enough
# that a PDCP entity keying its algorithms per packet again (+1.5 us with NIA2)
# fails; the rest at 3x. The one-shot cases are references, not bounded.
